name: Vicente Zavarce
scope: One dedicated fighter audit; no shared or runtime code changes, no commits, no new web research.

identityAndPortrayal.preservedDossier: Editorial interview dossier identifies Zavarce as Yummy's founder/cofounder and CEO. This audit uses that preserved context, without asserting a freshly verified current office.
identityAndPortrayal.visualMatch: Dark swept-back hair, rectangular black glasses, beard/stubble, black T-shirt and light jacket with purple rocket emblem are visible in the actual atlas. Glasses and jacket combine details from the two preserved references; the inspected Rocket portrait itself has no glasses.
identityAndPortrayal.fictionalAdaptation: VELOCIDAD role, phone presentation, courier dash and delivery-themed combo names fit the established Yummy portrayal. Fighting moves and presentation are fictional, not claims about real rituals or skills.
identityAndPortrayal.audioLimit: The Spanish greeting and attribution are preserved in the dossier, but this audit did not listen to audio or verify audiovisual synchronization.

movementAndStance.movement: From x540, 24 right inputs reach x668.428919921416; 24 subsequent left inputs reach x550.7707315970146. Facing follows both directions. Both sides give identical results.
movementAndStance.jump: First and second jumps leave the floor; a third input is rejected; landing restores grounded=true, y554 and jumps=0 with both stocks intact on Poliedro.
movementAndStance.stance: Ready frame0 faces correctly right and left. Block frame1 raises an open palm. Run frames2/3, tucked jump frame4, punch frame5, high kick frame6 and hurt frame7 were all inspected through production drawSprite in the native browser. No face reversal, clipping, borrowed limb or missing foot was observed in these views.

special.name: Entrega exprés
special.intendedDistinctBehavior: Fast close-range delivery rush, with lavender speed trails and short invulnerability; no projectile, teleport, trap, snare, or counter.
special.closeIdle: At gap120, on both sides, activation frame6 creates the dash and hits exactly once. Javier's hp becomes86.4452: 14*0.94*1.03=13.5548 damage.
special.closeBlock: At gap120, on both sides, a facing grounded guard preserves hp100 and emits a block effect. From energy60, the defender reaches50.28 after six calls, including the nine-point guard impact and held-block drain. Attacker energy reaches75.175 with no hit reward.
special.energyGate: Energy24 rejects special; energy100 permits it and consumes25 before any hit reward.

attacksAndCombos.light: Both sides connect once at gap80 for6.7774 damage against Javier, with correct outward knockback and light impact.
attacksAndCombos.heavy: Both sides connect once at gap80 for12.5866 damage against Javier, with correct outward knockback and heavy impact.
attacksAndCombos.baseCombo: Pedido confirmado (L→H) connects both strikes using actual chase inputs on both sides; Javier finishes hp77.546 after62 simulation ticks including approach and recovery.
attacksAndCombos.advancedCombo: Ruta directa (L→L→H) at one win connects all three strikes using actual chase inputs on both sides; Javier finishes hp66.6486 after104 simulation ticks. Heavy comboBonus is7. At zero wins the same input sequence retains the base combo and bonus3.
attacksAndCombos.definitive: Cohete a domicilio is the engine's close-range super, rather than a rocket projectile: three wins and75 energy required, startup9, range245, base28*0.94 plus12 combo bonus. Both sides at gap200 reduce Javier to hp60.5304. Zero wins or energy74 rejects it.
attacksAndCombos.recognitionLimit: Combo labels are input-history recognition, so setup lights outside range can still unlock the heavy bonus. Separate connected-combo tests verified that every named strike can also actually land.

cpuFight.method: Advance the actual510-frame intro, leave Vicente idle for240 calls so CPU offense is exercised, then approach, defend opportunistically, and press light/heavy/special/super using the deterministic controller in the dedicated test. Run the whole fight twice and compare every final state field.
cpuFight.interpretation: A complete exercised fight and deterministic replay; this is not a balance benchmark or an assertion that every attempted action hit.

introAndSelection.name: Confirma y señala el pedido
introAndSelection.actualAppChecks: Inspected the lobby's selected Zavarce ready stance and the actual match's initial split-screen cinematic after using the normal nickname and start controls.
introAndSelection.controlledVisualChecks: Imported the existing production loadSprite, drawPresentation, drawSprite and renderMatch modules in this agent's own native tab. An ephemeral browser canvas displayed intro and selection at0/.5/1, midpoint mirrored, every combat frame in both directions, and four special fixtures stepped through the real engine. No repository visual harness was written.
introAndSelection.observation: Midpoint intro raises/nods toward a clearly visible purple phone by the front hand; selection uses the same gesture at lower strength and opacity. The fists remain closed, so literal tapping or an extended pointing finger is not visible. Start and end return to ready frame0, the phone disappears at endpoints, and mirrored facing remains coherent.
introAndSelection.loopCheck: selectionProgress reaches1 at2800ms and remains1 at5600ms; production Portrait stops scheduling its selection animation at1. Presentation data uses a single preparation/accent/release.
introAndSelection.limitations: Static controlled snapshots verify appearance and facing at representative points; this audit did not claim to inspect every interpolated frame or listen to the greeting. A transient native MCP transport failure recovered before the controlled visual checks.

findings.summary: The delivery rush can pass through an idle fighter without a hit because collision is checked only on startup.
reproduction: createMatch('poliedro', [Zavarce wins3, Javier wins3]); advance510 empty inputs to finish intro.
Set Zavarce x250, Javier x450, both grounded at y554 with invincible0, Zavarce energy100; increment player0 actions.special once.
Run15 stepMatch calls with idle inputs afterward. Both fighters are at x450; Javier hp100 and Zavarce hits0.
At40 calls Javier still has hp100 and Zavarce is x928.4425. Mirroring the fixture on side1 gives the same gap200 miss and crossing.
findings.visualEvidence: Production renderMatch at gap200/call15 in native T3 shows both fighter silhouettes overlapping at x450 without a hit flash or health damage.
findings.cause: updateAttack uses the special pulse only at attackTick6 and marks attackHit before confirming a hurt result; there is no later courier collision check while dash>0.
findings.proposedFix: Keep courier's hit active from startup through the dash, with a separate single-connection gate. Apply special movement only on initial startup. Retry the melee collision while courier dash>0 and no successful connection has occurred; stop after hurt returns true, including a block or counter. Preserve one damage instance, current vertical/facing rules, energy cost and recovery.

findings.summary: Courier maintains full dash velocity throughout recovery, extending a configured200-pixel rush to640pixels before ordinary deceleration begins.
reproduction: Use the same completed-intro Poliedro fixture with Zavarce x250 and idle Javier x950 (gap700), energy100.
Increment actions.special, then run37 stepMatch calls with no movement.
Zavarce ends x890, vx20, dash0, attack=null, cooldown2:640pixels traveled, despite dash.speed20 and dash.ticks10.
At call16 in unobstructed range probes, dash is already0 but vx is still20 and attack is still special.
findings.cause: The ordinary velocity convergence is gated by !p.attack && !p.dash. courier has no dash.brake, so the ended dash's velocity persists through special recovery.
findings.proposedFix: Set courier-specific dash braking when its dash expires using the already supported Technique.dash.brake (for example0.2), or reset its velocity at that transition. Keep the configured ten active dash ticks and37-frame recovery; ensure input control resumes afterward. Test total displacement away from opponents and both arena edges.

verification.initialHarnessCorrection: The first CPU harness immediately attacked and expected the rival to land a hit; that expectation failed. It was changed to include240 idle calls so CPU offense is genuinely exercised, then passed. No runtime change was made to obtain the passing result.
verification.bugProbeSemantics: Distance/recovery probes log measured current behavior and assert finite physics; their passing result does not certify the two reported mismatches as fixed.
